jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join a team where innovation meets mission. Our AI, cloud, cyber, and modernization solutions save agencies thousands of hours, safeguard national security, and strengthen health and humanitarian missions worldwide. With 1,700+ team members, 1,500+ AI/data experts, and 100+ prime contracts, we deliver at scale and with purpose.

We’ve been recognized as a Top Workplace by the Washington Post for six straight years and named to the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies 13 of the past 14 years. Credence is a welcoming home for those looking to grow and contribute to positive change. We encourage all employees to expand beyond their boundaries, dive into important world-changing Federal challenges.

**Position Summary**

Credence has an immediate need for **a Senior AI Software Engineer** to join our growing AI and Automation practice. In this role, you will serve as a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, and deploying advanced AI-driven solutions, including generative AI, LLM-powered applications, and agentic AI systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering, data, cloud, and stakeholder teams to deliver scalable, secure, and mission-focused AI capabilities for federal clients, while helping guide technical direction, strengthen engineering practices, and mentor other engineers.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below**

* **Generative AI & LLM Solution Delivery**  
  Lead the design, development, prototyping, and refinement of AI-powered capabilities using generative AI, large language models, retrieval patterns, prompt/context engineering, and secure API integrations.
* **Agentic AI System Development**  
  Own end-to-end agentic AI development lifecycles, including model selection, agent design, tool/function calling, orchestration, response synthesis, evaluation, and deployment of reliable AI agents.
* **Senior Software Engineering Leadership**  
  Apply strong software engineering principles to design maintainable, testable, and scalable systems; conduct code reviews, establish technical patterns, and leverage AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate delivery.
* **Cross-Functional Technical Collaboration**  
  Partner with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, cloud engineers, and mission stakeholders to translate business and mission needs into operational AI and automation solutions.
* **Cloud Enablement & DevSecOps Integration**  
  Design and automate deployment workflows using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, containers, and cloud-native services to support secure, repeatable, and scalable AI delivery.
* **Production Monitoring & Optimization**  
  Monitor AI systems post-deployment, perform performance tuning, and apply best practices for reliability and scalability.
* **Technical Rigor & Documentation**  
  Write clean, well-documented code following industry and federal guidelines; support reproducible development.
* **Technical Mentorship & Continuous Improvement**  
  Stay current on emerging AI/ML trends, agentic frameworks, model capabilities, and engineering practices while mentoring team members and contributing to reusable standards, documentation, and technical design reviews.

  
**Requirements**

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
* 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience delivering AI/ML, generative AI, or LLM-powered solutions in production or production-like environments.
* Experience building generative AI applications, working with LLMs, implementing tool/function calling, and applying model evaluation, prompt/context engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation approaches.
* Experience designing or implementing agentic AI solutions using frameworks or platforms such as Agent2Agent Protocol, Bedrock Agents, Mastra, CrewAI, Strands, AgentCore, LangChai

jobs.title: SDET - Delivery Management Engineer II
jobs.description:

We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Delivery Management Engineer, you will be responsible for:  

* Supporting implementation and operations management activities across project workstreams
* Producing deliverables and reviewing team outputs for quality and accuracy

A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

**The team**  
  
Deloitte's Government and Public Services (GPS) practice is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, and local government clients, as well as public higher education institutions, the team brings experience in strategy, technology, and operations to help clients address complex mission challenges. Within this environment, GPS HST Technology professionals support programs that improve service delivery, operational effectiveness, and constituent outcomes.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**

* Ability to travel 0-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

**Preferred:**

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: NX Developer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Team**

The Engineering Systems and Tools team designs, builds, and maintains internal systems, applications, and infrastructure across the enterprise. We are looking for an NX Developer to join our team and develop customizations, automation, and administrative tooling for our Siemens NX CAD environment.

### **About the Role**

Anduril's engineers design and build autonomous systems that protect those who serve. Behind every model, drawing, and assembly is the Siemens NX environment that makes rapid iteration possible. As an NX Developer on the Engineering Systems and Tools team, you'll be the person who makes that environment faster, smarter, and more reliable — building custom automation, tooling, and integrations that let our mechanical and electrical engineers focus on the work that matters instead of fighting their tools. You'll write real code (NXOpen API, Python, C++), own the full lifecycle of internal developer tools, and work directly with the engineers who depend on them. This isn't IT support - it's product development for an internal user base that's building things that actually matter.

**What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain NX Open API customizations (NX Open C/C++, NX Open Python, NX Open .NET) to automate repetitive design tasks and enforce engineering standards
* Build and manage NX CAD administrative tools including templates, part families, reuse libraries, and check-mate rules to ensure consistency across the engineering organization
* Create custom NX dialogs, menus, and toolbars that streamline workflows for mechanical and electrical design teams
* Develop journal-based automation scripts and NX Open applications to accelerate modeling, drafting, and BOM generation processes
* Collaborate with PLM engineers to ensure seamless NX–Teamcenter integration in managed mode, including classification, naming rules, and revision workflows
* Work with a high-functioning team of solution engineers and cross-functional teams with an emphasis on finishing business-critical projects
* Help troubleshoot NX technical issues including those related to deployment, site configuration, custom toolkit distribution, and ongoing end-user support

**Who You Are:**  
Anduril is an extremely fast-paced defense technology startup that is rapidly scaling itself. Our culture is one of ambition, hard work, relentless pursuit of excellence, and deliberate disruption. The successful candidate will be one who demonstrates the follow core characteristics:

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
***Note:*** *Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.*

**Our Story**
-------------

Partly's mission is to connect the world's parts and we're doing that by building the first global platform for replacement parts, starting with auto parts. Our big vision is to accelerate the world towards a sustainable future where waste is eliminated and all replacement parts are universally searchable, accessible and available to all.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we utilise bleeding-edge technology to solve challenging but exciting problems that make a huge impact in a $1.9 trillion industry. We've more than tripled our team over the last 12 months and expect to double in size again over the coming 12 months. We're a global team spanning both Europe and Australasia.

We provide a scalable digital infrastructure solution to some of the world's largest businesses and the most exciting startups. Partly's solutions are integrated across hundreds of companies globally, providing the backbone for cataloguing and managing parts online.

Our investors in Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), Square Peg, Octopus Ventures, Icehouse, Peter Beck (Rocket Lab), Akshay Kothari (Notion Co-Founder) and Dylan Field (Figma Co-Founder).

We're continuing to build a world-class team and ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built at Partly, and our values are lived throughout every experience.

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Repairers train for years to be on the tools, then spend half their day on quotes, paperwork and finding parts. Partly's product aims to automate the admin so repairers can focus on their craft. The products we've launched this year start with a conversation, and behind it a system generates the interface the moment needs. So we no longer design a set of pages. We design components, and then we design the brain the AI uses to assemble them. Very few designers have done this yet. That's the opportunity: to work out what product design becomes at an AI company, in a domain where a wrong answer is a $1,000 part that can't be returned.

The problems are real and unsolved. How does someone who's never used a chat interface know what to ask when they land on an empty box between phone calls? How does a task you do forty times a day become one tap, not one more sentence to type, with the same result every time? How much of the agent's reasoning do you show before trust turns into a wall of text? Where should the interface be opinionated, and where should it be generated? We don't have the answers yet. You'll own finding Partly's.

**The role**
============

Our product teams are organised around a product, each led by a Product Lead (Principal Product Manager) with a Product Engineer and a mix of engineers. Design is not embedded in those teams. We're building a global design team that works across all of our products and is focused on three things: the design system everything is built from, coherence across the whole product family, and the quality of the experience wherever a repairer or supplier meets us. Our customers range from repairers and parts admins in a single independent workshop to multi-billion-dollar repair groups, and the suppliers who provide their parts. The team exists to drive adoption and stickiness through experiences that feel magical, in a way that works for our customers. We work collaboratively with the Product Leads who drive their products.

This is a senior design role for someone with incredible judgement and hands-on experience with AI surfaces and experiences. You lead with design: problem framing, sys

jobs.title: Test Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI. If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for Test Systems Engineers to build the machines that test our robots and to keep our new test lab running. You will design automated test rigs, data logging, and dashboards so durability tests can run around the clock, and you will run whole-robot functional and working-condition tests that reflect how customers actually use our robots. You are the force multiplier: the more you automate, the more the team can test.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, build, and maintain automated test stations and rigs combining mechanical fixtures, motors, sensors, PLCs or microcontrollers, and software
* Build data acquisition and logging systems, and dashboards that track test status and results across all test stations
* Automate long-duration durability and duty-cycle tests to run unattended overnight and on weekends, with alerts and automatic shutdown on failure — scaling to dozens of modules on test in parallel
* Qualify every test station for accuracy, repeatability, and stability before its data is trusted
* Design simple interface boards and harnesses for test setups, and work with equipment suppliers on custom stations
* Run whole-robot functional tests: mobility, manipulation, payload, terrain, and continuous operation
* Develop and run working-condition tests based on real customer scenarios and environments
* Assemble, configure, and prepare robots and subsystems for testing
* Keep the lab running: equipment setup and calibration, spare parts and inventory, and lab safety (battery handling, robot motion safety zones)
* Support mechanical and electrical test engineers in executing their test plans

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* BS in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Robotics Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience
* 3+ years building test equipment, automation, or robotic systems
* Proficiency in Python for automation and data handling, and comfort with Linux command line
* Hands-on experience with sensors, motors, and DAQ or PLC systems
* Comfortable with mechanical assembly, wiring, and basic fabrication
* Strong troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical, and software

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with ROS/ROS 2 or robot middleware
* Experience building test dashboards and databases
* Background in robotics competitions, makerspaces, or building robots end-to-end
* Experience running a hardware lab, including equipment calibration and safety programs

jobs.title: Electrical & Firmware Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI. If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for an Electrical & Firmware Test Engineer to make sure the electrical systems and embedded software in Dexmate robots work reliably in the real world. You will own validation of power systems, batteries, boards, harnesses, and motor controllers, and build the hardware-in-the-loop infrastructure that tests our firmware before it reaches a robot. You will find problems before customers do — and help fix them.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and execute electrical validation plans for power distribution, battery packs and BMS, custom boards, motor drives, sensors, harnesses, and connectors
* Define reliability test flows for PCBAs, harnesses, and connectors, and run them: power cycling, brown-out and fault conditions, high temperature/high humidity, thermal cycling and shock, connector and harness flex/wear, and long-duration burn-in
* Run ESD and EMC pre-compliance testing; support FCC, CE, and UL certification with external labs
* Validate battery safety and performance, and support battery certification (IEC 62133, UN38.3)
* Build and maintain hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test rigs for motor controllers, joint modules, and main compute boards
* Develop automated firmware regression tests covering communications (CAN, EtherCAT, Ethernet), control loops, safety behaviors, and OTA updates
* Perform fault-injection testing to verify error handling and safe-state behavior
* Lead electrical failure analysis at board and system level, working with electrical and firmware engineers to drive fixes
* Write test procedures and maintain test data and reports

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
* 4+ years in electrical validation, hardware test, or embedded test for robotics, automotive, industrial, or consumer electronics
* Strong bench skills: oscilloscopes, current probes, power analyzers, electronic loads, thermal cameras
* Experience testing power electronics, battery systems, or motor drives
* Ability to read schematics and debug at board level
* Proficiency in Python for test automation and comfort working in Linux
* Familiarity with embedded systems and communication buses (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience building HIL test systems and firmware CI pipelines
* Experience with EtherCAT or real-time motor control systems
* Hands-on EMC/ESD pre-compliance testing and certification experience (FCC, CE, UL)
* Knowledge of battery safety standards (IEC 62133, UN38.3, UL 2271)
* Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 13849, IEC 61508)
* Ability to read and write embedded C/C++

jobs.title: Mechanical & Durability Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI. If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for Mechanical & Durability Test Engineers to prove that our robots are strong, stable, and built to last. You will own mechanical validation across our robots — from defining test plans and building fixtures to running durability campaigns and tearing down failed parts to find root cause. You will set how mechanical testing is done at Dexmate, and your sign-off will decide whether hardware is ready to ship.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Translate real customer usage profiles into lab test specs and reliability targets, even when field data is still limited
* Define and execute mechanical validation plans for robot structures, joints, actuators, gearboxes, bushings, end effectors, and mobile bases at component, subsystem, and full-robot level
* Run strength, stiffness, stability, and tip-over tests; drop, impact, and collision tests; and static and dynamic load tests
* Design and run accelerated life and durability tests on joints, actuators, cables, and wear components, including continuous duty-cycle runs on full robots
* Run environmental tests — vibration, shock, thermal cycling, humidity, and dust/water ingress — in-house or with external labs
* Design and build test fixtures, jigs, and stands (CAD through fabrication)
* Instrument tests with strain gauges, load cells, torque sensors, encoders, and DAQ; analyze and report results
* Correlate test data with FEA/CAE models and feed findings back to design engineers
* Lead mechanical failure analysis: teardowns, root cause, corrective action, and verification of fixes; build and maintain a failure-mode database that feeds back into design
* Turn test data into statistical risk assessments (e.g., Weibull life estimates) and present clear ship/no-ship recommendations to leadership
* Work with suppliers on part-level qualification and with outside labs on certification testing
* Write clear test procedures that technicians and our Shenzhen team can run consistently

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* BS in Mechanical Engineering or related field
* 4+ years in mechanical test, validation, or reliability engineering for robotics, automotive, aerospace, industrial equipment, or consumer hardware
* Hands-on experience instrumenting tests with strain gauges, load cells, and DAQ systems
* Experience designing and running fatigue, durability, or accelerated life tests
* Proficiency in CAD (SolidWorks, Onshape, or equivalent) for fixture design
* Hands-on with shop tools and comfortable building your own test setups
* Strong root-cause analysis skills and clear technical writing

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience testing actuators, gearboxes (harmonic, planetary, cycloidal), or legged/wheeled robots
* Experience with vibration, shock, thermal, and IP testing and relevant standards (IEC 60068, IEC 60529)
* Familiarity with FEA and test-to-simulation correlation
* Knowledge of reliability methods: FMEA, Weibull analysis, HALT/HASS
* Python, MATLAB, or JMP for test data analysis
* Experience with failure analysis tools such as X-ray/CT, microscopy, or cross-sectioning
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers in Asia

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer
jobs.description:
**About us**
============

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

**Job:** We’re hiring a senior brand designer who’s a generalist first, with a particular strength in technical storytelling and information design. You’ll help explain a deeply technical product to a wider audience, and apply and extend our brand system across the work we put into the world.

You’ll be part of the design team, working closely with technical marketing and DevRel to shape the story from the first outline. The work includes diagrams, benchmark and eval visualizations, docs and API illustrations, and visual essays like The Web as Ground Truth. You’ll also work across launch pages, blog art direction, conference and keynote graphics, motion, and social.

**You:** Your portfolio shows strong typography, composition, and range across brand, web, and motion. You can learn a complex subject, find the idea that matters, and explain it at different levels of depth. You bring ideas to the narrative and are comfortable working through them in prototypes and motion. Experience with developer or technical products is a plus, as is a strong writing instinct. You can handle a high volume of work, make good decisions quickly, and follow through on the production details.

**About Parallel Design:** We design for a web used by both people and agents, grounding our work in real code, data, and evidence. We draw from the history of the web, computing, and publishing to help explain what comes next, while leaving room for experiments, tangents, and things made simply because they’re good.

**Life at Parallel**
====================

Our team works **fully in-person**, between our Palo Alto HQ and San Francisco office. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.

We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

* **Own customer impact:** It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.
* **Obsess over craft:** Perfect every detail because quality compounds.
* **Accelerate change**: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.
* **Create win-wins**: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.
* **Make high-conviction bets**: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount.

**Compensation & benefits**
===========================

* Competitive salary
* Generous equity
* Visa sponsorships
* 401K plans
* Daily lunch & office snacks
* Dinner at the office
* Unlimited vacation
* Caltrain pass reimbursement

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Robotics Solution Delivery
jobs.description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what's possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

**Role**
--------

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM), you'll manage the delivery of cutting edge automation technology and robotic solutions to our customers and partners. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some amazing and talented people, who also happen to be working on highly creative and ambitious efforts.

You will manage and coordinate engagements with industry leading companies and partners of Intrinsic. * Build physical climate risk models using state-of-the-art methodologies including AI numerical weather prediction applied to climate applications; stochastic ensembles; earth observing foundation models; as well as traditional physics-based models.
* Collaborate with our climate scientists, hydrologists, fire scientists, data scientists, and data engineers to translate business requirements into scientific solutions.
* Partner with data, cloud, and security teams to design scalable and maintainable scientific modeling pipelines.
* Foster a culture of scientific rigor and excellence in model design, including conducting validation studies to guide continuous improvement of those models.

Your Key Ressponsibilities:

* Lead a team of scientists to architect and implement models for climate risk assessment.
* Create robust, reproducible physical models which will stand up to peer review and validate well globally in a changing climate.
* Lead the establishment of standards, methodologies, and techniques for modeling physical risk, including how it is changing due to climate change.
* Organize and facilitate team activities for tracking work progress, communicate with internal stakeholders in product and sales teams, and align timelines and deliveries with project managers.

jobs.title: Support Engineer - Configuration
jobs.description:
**Support Engineer – Oracle Health**

**Locations:** Kansas City, MO | Nashville, TN | Orlando, FL (Onsite – 3 days/week)

US Citizenship required and must be able to obtain Public Trust Clearance and/or any other clearances required by our client(s)

The Support Engineer I – Configuration provides post implementation and sustainment support for assigned Oracle Health products. This role partners with customers to understand and complete configuration change requests within their domain, including design additions or modifications, testing, validation, and ongoing support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Customer Support and Configuration Delivery**

* Serve as a primary customer contact through phone or electronic channels.

* Gather requirements, document, configure, test, and validate approved customer change requests.

* Provide support for design additions or modifications and communicate progress and resolution throughout the request lifecycle.

* Troubleshoot and resolve routine configuration and technical issues; escalate complex issues to appropriate technical teams or experienced peers.

* Coordinate with peers to report and support resolution of product design, reliability, maintenance, or defect concerns.

**Documentation and Collaboration**

* Maintain accurate service request, change request, and product documentation.

* Use and contribute to troubleshooting guides, configuration documentation, and Knowledge Base articles.

* Partner with internal teams and stakeholders to address customer situations and technical issues.

* Build knowledge of assigned Oracle product ecosystems and customer environments.

**Support Enhancement and Performance**

* Use automation and AI assisted tools to investigate common issues, identify root causes, and improve efficiency.

* Identify opportunities to improve change request workflows, support processes, documentation, and best practices.

* Monitor assigned service performance metrics and complete work within established timelines.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Follow established procedures to prioritize tasks, troubleshoot common issues, and escalate concerns as needed.

* Collaborate with team members to support customer and business needs.

* Continue developing configuration, product, and technical support knowledge through training, feedback, and hands on experience.

* Provide oral and written translation support for technical and non technical inquiries, as needed.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Investigate and resolve client issues by analyzing front-end applications, gathering details, shadowing users, and testing workflows
* Perform back-end troubleshooting, including capturing logs, querying database tables, updating fields, and cycling servers
* Respond to customer inquiries (technical and non-technical) via phone, email, and messaging platforms
* Collaborate cross-functionally to escalate and resolve complex or critical issues
* Document all troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and knowledge articles throughout the issue lifecycle
* Prioritize workload effectively to meet service level expectations and client needs
* Provide guidance and support to internal stakeholders on escalated customer situations
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment by sharing knowledge and supporting peers
Participate in after-hours, weekend, and holiday on-call rotations for critical issue support  

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, IT services, or healthcare industry
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Experience with troubleshooting, help desk environments, or ticketing systems
* Ability to work onsite 3 days per week in one of the designated hub locations
Ability to obtain required government security clearance  

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic IT and networking knowledge
* Experience with SQL or querying databases
* Familiarity with CCL, HL7, or healt
